assessments.reasoning: The language reference describes programming for two named IBM compiler products, then separately identifies the PL/I language and the source elements used to write a PL/I program.

challenge.method: Compared the edition statement, the workstation-only feature convention, the Program elements section and the explicitly selected ANSI features against the compiler’s separate product identification.
challenge.results: The reference supplies the language referent and records the product conditions under which its descriptions apply. The word PL/I still identifies the programming language. The product editions and the delimited subset are separate.

limitations: The applicability notice lists both z/OS 6.1 and the Windows 9.1 offering. Platform-specific features and conformance require their own evidence.
